summary: Backend pytest suite (25/25 passed) covers auth (cookie+Bearer), admin gating, events CRUD with image upload, registration uniqueness, location ownership, help/sos status (owner & admin), file serving and cascade delete. Frontend Admin flow verified via Playwright: login (admin@roadtrip.com/admin123) → /admin Command Center → Create Event dialog (data-testid=create-event-button) creates event, sidebar shows event code (e.g., IXDXLH) and 'PARTICIPANTS (0)'. Participant UI flow could not be completed in same session due to relative-link navigation in test script, but the underlying APIs are fully validated and the /register page renders and submits per backend tests.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console)

action_items: Add aria-describedby/Description to Radix DialogContent to silence a11y warning

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed cookies under wildcard; cookie-based auth across origins will not work. Bearer fallback (currently used by frontend) saves the day, but if you intend cookie auth in production set explicit origin.

Consider adding data-testid attributes on Login/Register inputs and on participant Join/help/sos elements explicitly (most exist; verify my-help-banner, my-sos-banner, help-button, sos-button render in ParticipantDashboard for E2E tests)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS misconfig: allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; switch to explicit origin list when relying on httpOnly cookies
Bcrypt hash is generated correctly ($2b$ format) via bcrypt.hashpw — OK
Seed admin updates password if changed — idempotent OK
Mongo _id excluded everywhere via projection — OK
/api/files/{path} streams full content into memory — fine for small avatars but not large files; consider StreamingResponse for big assets
Single 400-line server.py is acceptable for MVP; if it grows split into routers (auth/events/registrations/files)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (admin verified end-to-end; participant verified via API only)

test_credentials: admin@roadtrip.com / admin123 (seeded). Fresh participants created per-test via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed events/users/registrations and clean up the event+registration created during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_roadtrip_api.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. All 25 cases pass against live preview URL.
